AUTHOR: Sokolova
TITLE: A Deep Learning Approach to Assist Sustainability of Demersal Trawling Operations
REGION: Skagerrak (Denmark), RV Havfisken, Nephrops-directed demersal trawling
SPECIES: Four catch categories: Nephrops norvegicus, round fish (cod, hake, saithe), flat fish (plaice, dab etc.), other (non-commercial fish, invertebrates)
DATA: Own in-trawl video from 19 hauls (1.5 h each); 4385 annotated training frames; two test videos (Towing 27,000 frames, Haul-back 23,100 frames) plus nine whole-haul videos; test data in DTU repository
V_EV: Section 3.3: 'the trawl gets in contact with the seabed which causes increased sediment resuspension, the presence of which contributes to the count bias towards false positive detections.'
D2: Training set 4385 images split 88/12 train/validation (unit not stated); separate test videos 'Towing' and 'Haul-back'
D_EV: no statement found on the split unit or on whether test videos/hauls were excluded from training; Section 2.1 only states 'split in train and validation subsets as 88% and 12%'
R_EV: Section 2.5: 'we have selected two test videos. One with the average catch rate corresponding to typical conditions during towing ... and the other with the higher occlusion rate'
C_EV: Section 4.2: 'The duplicate counts of the objects escaping from the top band of the frame were accounted for by introducing a filter in the top fifth rows of the frame.'
E_EV: Section 2.6: 'Predicted count for the whole haul was then compared with the manual count of the catch captured by the in-trawl image acquisition system and the actual catch count performed onboard the vessel.'
ARCH: Mask R-CNN (ResNet-101-FPN) with Copy-Paste/colour/blur/cloud augmentation + adapted SORT tracker (Kalman, Mahalanobis, matching cascade, class evidence vector, top-band filter)
METR: Track-level precision, recall, F-score per class; absolute error of automated vs manual (video) and onboard catch counts
NOTE: Text is heavily garbled (duplicated two-column layout) but readable. Split unit for 88/12 train/val not stated and independence of the two test videos from training hauls not stated, so D1=NR (a charitable reading would be video-level). Towing vs Haul-back are condition subsets (occlusion, panel stability) within the same campaign, not external (P2). V6=P because performance differs by phase and count error is attributed qualitatively to sediment resuspension; no measured visibility. Track confidence score is computed (softmax evidence vector) but no detection threshold reported (C1=NR); duplicate-count filter gives C5. Onboard catch count = independent reference (trawl catch), although onboard counts only cover commercial species per class; text notes 73% of Nephrops recorded by camera (camera coverage, not AI FNR; E4 left 없음). TAXA coded 과/속 수준 for coarse morphological groups (incl. non-fish Nephrops); ENV options do not fit demersal soft-bottom, coded NR. DSHR: test/count data public (DTU repository), training data on request.
